No platform CPU speed or guessed refresh frequency participates in arithmetic or retrace counts.

indirect.vectors: Install sets INT24 to FailDosCriticalError through DOS21, without saving/restoring the previous vector. No native dispatch target identity is embedded in ordinary code.
indirect.returns: Fail handler sets liveIF with STI and returns AL3 through the original IRET service frame; IRET restores the interrupted flags. No chaining or DOS call in handler.
indirect.callbacks: No native callback or new indirect grammar. Page/palette far pointers are borrowed data, not code targets.

memory.owner: One original GAME video owner, with DS-selected palette/source pointer cells. VideoPages is an ephemeral view, never a second global owner.
memory.palette: Source pointer static bank first384 bytes duplicated with second-half-first word stores; BaseRgbPalette768 and FadedRgbPalette768 (loc_4981 alias) remain their original storage.
memory.meaning: Offsets are byte addresses per VGA plane. CRTC display start is the newly displayed offset. Background is saved scenery/collision/latch/rain restoration storage; fixed0 serves below the gameplay line compare. Banks are not reset by offset-only configuration.
memory.aliases: Model completeness=false retained: unknown far/indexed malformed writes may alias owner cells. No restrictive general no-alias assertion; generated duplicate/chunky cases include overlap, physical aliases, odd word wrap and aperture sources.

retained: Palette scale is AH(low16(byte*factor)), no saturation/mask; raw eight-bit outputs are masked to six bits by DAC service. Computes768 bytes descending767..0, uploads217 entries0..216 only. Base uploader sends256 entries0..255.

DAC write index reset occurs once per upload/blacken; component/index auto-increment persists across eight blackening waits. Blacken sends32 RGB triples per wait, eight batches; CLI/STI forceIF on. Fade in/out use65 factors inclusive0..256/256..0 in steps4, liveCX reread after each callee; out restores callerCX.
Palette duplication reads192 words once each; writes destination+384 before destination, incomingDF and word/cursor wrap exact. No second source half read.

Mode setup performs original seven ordered register updates/RMW masks and attributeOR20, with height192/count4800 or200/count3E80. Initial gameplay offsets0/A88/5A08/A988 (fixed/display/draw/background) versus picture0/0/3E80/7D00; both tail-swap draw/display. Segment words survive.

Clear selects all four planes then32768 zero STOSW operands in incomingDF order; VGA write modes/latches remain caller state, so no invented whole-device memset. Chunky emits1,2,4,8 masks for four sequential source bytes at each destination, advancing destination once per group; count0 means65536 groups, final mask15.
Swap exchanges offsets before waiting inactive only, writes CRTC0C high then0D low, restores registers before frame service. No guaranteed complete retrace or double swap of segment words.

Active/inactive are level waits. Next=inactive then active; Through=active then inactive. Zero count wraps to65536 Next waits. Active invokes original retrace service even if level already active; inactive does not.

Input timeout discards initial change, services/polls scan before buttons, then waits a Next retrace and decrements only no-input iterations; button/timeout returns39h and current remainingCX, scan returns raw packed result. Failure exits preserve prefix.
DOS install never saves/restores priorINT24; handler unconditionallyAL3, with temporary liveSTI beforeIRET. No repair or invented chain.
